assessment: This important study leverages the power of Drosophila genetics and sparsely-labeled neurons to propose an intriguing new model for neuronal injury signaling. The authors present convincing evidence to show that the somatic response to axonal injury can be suppressed if the injury is not complete, suggesting the presence of a new mode of injury 'integration.' While the underlying mechanism of this fascinating observation has yet to be determined, the phenomenon itself will be of broad significance in the field.
